name: fulgor: i hate, therefore i am.
source:
With Hatred dead, no one can oppose the legions of the She-Wolf; they roam the countryside, a horde of men and violence, razing any settlements they encounter and leaving no prisoners.

Only you can stop them.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3927060/fulgor_i_hate_therefore_i_am/]Steam[/url]]
